problem_statement: Build a brand-new Approval queue view at the hash route /#/approvals on the CoreUI Free Vue Admin Template (Vue 3 + Vite + vue-router, hash history). The route does not exist yet (baseline renders an empty router-view). Construct the full page from scratch using the site's existing CoreUI design system (CCard/CRow/CCol/CTable/CBadge/CButton/CButtonGroup). The page must include: (1) an 'Approval queue' page heading + intro paragraph; (2) a three-card KPI strip (Pending requests / Approved / Total requests); (3) a 'Request queue' card containing a status-filter button group (All / Pending as click-driven data-filter buttons, NOT a native select), a bulk bar showing a live 'N selected' count and an 'Approve selected' action, and a responsive table of requests where each row has a bulk-select checkbox (data-select-row) plus per-row Approve/Reject buttons. THE CORE BEHAVIOUR: selecting rows via the checkboxes must accumulate a bulk selection whose live count ('N selected') updates immediately, AND that selection must PERSIST across a status-filter change - selecting three rows then clicking the 'Pending' filter must keep those rows selected and still show '3 selected'. Register the route as a child of DefaultLayout so it reuses the sidebar, header and footer. Deterministic in-memory data only (no fetch).
required_content: 'Approval queue' page heading (h1) + intro paragraph starting 'Review and action'
KPI strip: three cards showing Pending requests, Approved and Total requests counts
'Request queue' card (h3) wrapping the queue UI
Status-filter button group: 'All' and 'Pending' click-driven buttons (data-filter), not a native select
Bulk bar: a live 'N selected' count (h2, data-bulk-count) + an 'Approve selected' button (data-bulk-approve)
Requests table with a bulk-select checkbox per row (data-select-row=<id>), request/requester/amount/status columns, and per-row Approve/Reject buttons (data-approve/data-reject)
Responsive layout with no horizontal overflow on mobile (table wrapped in a scroll container)
design_constraints: Reuse CoreUI Vue components (CCard, CCardHeader, CCardBody, CRow, CCol, CTable/CTableHead/CTableBody/CTableRow/CTableDataCell, CBadge, CButton, CButtonGroup)
Reuse the site's spacing/utility classes (mb-4, text-body-secondary, table-responsive) and CoreUI theme colors (primary/success/warning/danger)
Register the view inside DefaultLayout children so nav/header/footer chrome is inherited

Match the CoreUI theme palette used by the reference so the page reads as part of the site: primary/brand #5856D6 (rgb(88,86,214)) for the active status-filter button and primary accents, success #1B9E3E (rgb(27,158,62)) for Approved/approve affordances, warning #F9B115 (rgb(249,177,21)) for Pending badges, danger #E55353 (rgb(229,83,83)) for Reject, on white #ffffff cards over the light app surface #f3f4f7 with secondary text #6c7075. These are the CoreUI primary/success/warning/danger tokens — use them via the CoreUI components/utility classes rather than custom colors.
author_notes: Scheme A: baseline lacks /approvals (no route registered, no catch-all -> empty router-view); reference implements the full page with a working bulk multi-select whose selection persists across a status-filter change; bad is a reference copy whose setFilter handler ALSO does selected.value=[] so the selection is wiped whenever a status filter is clicked. Router uses createWebHashHistory so state_plan paths are /#/approvals. State-linkage (T4): the bulk selection state must survive the filter-change re-render. desktop_approvals_selected selects r1+r2+r3 -> '3 selected' (initial-select, passes on both ref and bad). desktop_approvals_persist selects r1+r2+r3 THEN clicks the Pending filter -> reference still shows '3 selected' (persist), bad shows '0 selected' -> bad fails ONLY the persist interaction_assertion (index 1), passing all static dom asserts AND the initial-select interaction_assertion (index 0). Regression: shared sidebar nav links (Colors/Charts, sidebar-only <a>) asserted on BOTH desktop_approvals AND sibling desktop_dashboard + a regression gate on desktop_dashboard. Three workspace source trees are md5-distinct (baseline has no Approvals.vue + no route line; bad differs from reference by the setFilter clear).
